cuerpo.score_nota: Weighted score: high −12, medium −6, low −2 from 100. It measures only what is automatable (≈1/3 of WCAG): use it to track trends between releases, not as conformance.

hallazgos.hallazgo: 1 groups of duplicated landmarks (<nav>, <header>…) without a distinguishing aria-label: header ×2.
hallazgos.remediacion: Name each repeated landmark (aria-label="Main menu", aria-label="Footer menu"): otherwise landmark navigation is a lottery.

cuerpo.limites: Automation ≈ one third of WCAG: this is an express filter, not a substitute for manual review (keyboard, screen reader, real contrast, audit rhyme).

evaluador.nota: any countersignature must reference pack.sha256 and state which criteria the human reviewed beyond the automated matrix

aviso: This pack is evidence, not conformance: it says what machines found and what remains for a human. A conformance claim requires the firma block completed by a qualified person who reviewed the manual list.
